name: OverlayManager
purpose: Host authored Brick overlays by stable ID and await typed results separately from completed exits.
useWhen: Multiple application locations need to open, update or await an overlay instance.

avoidWhen.condition: A single local disclosure is sufficient.

composition: Create one manager with createOverlay and mount its Viewport below application providers. Forward manager-owned open, onOpenChange and onExitComplete to the authored overlay Root.

rules.statement: Keep lifecycle fields out of authored props. Await open for a result and close or waitForExit for completed exit.
Mount exactly one Viewport before opening; use request-scoped managers in SSR applications.
The manager is CSS-free. Load the styles required by the actual Dialog, Drawer, ActionBar or FloatingPanel composition.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using a timer in the manager to guess animation completion.
commonMistakes.correction: Forward onExitComplete to the overlay behavior owner.
Use application state for reactive displays. A never-committed overlay closes without visual exit; committed overlays still report exit completion.

validation: Verify result/exit ordering, removal, host disposal, updates, same-ID reopening, focus restoration and provider inheritance.
